pull.meaning: downloads new commits from the remote and merges them into your branch.
pull.resultZero: {remote} had nothing new — you're already up to date.
steps: reached out to {remote}
found {n} new commit{s} you didn't have yet
merged them into {branch}
stepsZero: it has nothing you don't already have
pull.authError: you're not logged in to pull from this remote.
pull.networkError: couldn't reach {remote} — check your network or VPN connection.

push.meaning: uploads your commits so the remote matches your branch.
push.resultZero: nothing to push — {remote} already matches your branch.
steps: checked what {remote} already has
sent it the {n} commit{s} it was missing
{remote} now matches {branch}
stepsZero: it already matches your branch — nothing to send
push.authError: you're not logged in to push to this remote.
push.networkError: couldn't reach {remote} — check your network or VPN connection.

stash.meaning: sets uncommitted changes aside so your working directory is clean.
stash.result: saved {n} changed file{s} — bring them back with stash pop.
stash.resultZero: nothing to save — no changed files.
steps: took every tracked change out of your working directory
saved {n} file{s} as a stash entry
your working directory is clean now
stepsZero: nothing tracked was changed — there was nothing to set aside

commit.meaning: saves your staged changes as a new point in your branch's history.
steps: packaged the {n} file{s} you staged
created a new commit on {branch}
{branch}'s tip moved forward to it

switchBranch.meaning: points your working directory at a different branch.
steps: checked your working directory was safe to switch
moved HEAD to {branch}
your files now match {branch}'s last commit

createBranch.meaning: creates a new branch starting from {from}, and switches to it.
steps: created a new branch pointer at {from}
switched your working directory to it
{branch} points at the same commit as {from} for now — they'll diverge once you commit

revert.meaning: undoes commits by adding a new commit that reverses them — nothing is deleted from history.
steps: found the {n} commit{s} after {target}
created new commit{s} that undo exactly their changes
nothing was deleted — {target} and everything after it still exist in history
revert.confirmText: this adds new commit{s} that undo the {n} commit{s} after {target} — none of them are deleted, and this is safe even if they've been pushed. continue?

undo.meaning: reverses your last action so things are back to how they were.
steps: found exactly what your last action changed
reversed it
nothing else was touched
